items.html: How so? The Nefesh, which is revealed in the liver, which is opposite the heads of the articles of the NHY, as mentioned — certainly it was also above in all the aspects of the outer vessels, the upper ones. However, it was not revealed and did not rise in name until the NHY of ZA, for there stand the NHY of the NHY, and the NHY of the ChGT, and the NHY of the KHB, and all of them are the aspect of Nefesh and NHY.
